BiblicalUsage: Nephisim is a family of temple servants named in the return lists of both Ezra and Nehemiah, counted among those who came back from exile to serve the house of God. Their name sits among the other servant families, with no story attached — only the fact that they returned and their children were counted.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that being counted among the servants is itself the honour: no deed is recorded, only that they came home to serve God's house.
